- A Flutter-style vertical `Column`
- [color](https://docs.rs/macro.color.html)
- A CSS-style color literal, producing a gpui `Hsla`.
- [hstack](https://docs.rs/macro.hstack.html)
- A themed horizontal `Group`
- [kbd](https://docs.rs/macro.kbd.html)
- A `Kbd``format!`arguments.
- [modal](https://docs.rs/macro.modal.html)
- A `Modal``.title(..)`and`.on_close(..)`after.
- [paper](https://docs.rs/macro.paper.html)
- A `Paper`
- [row](https://docs.rs/macro.row.html)
- A Flutter-style horizontal `Row`
- [style](https://docs.rs/macro.style.html)
- A CSS-like style block. Expands to an element transform applied with
`StyleExt::apply`
- [text](https://docs.rs/macro.text.html)
- `Text`- `format!`arguments.
- [title](https://docs.rs/macro.title.html)
- `Title`- `format!`arguments.
- [vstack](https://docs.rs/macro.vstack.html)
- A themed vertical `Stack`
- [wrap](https://docs.rs/macro.wrap.html)
- A wrapping row, `Wrap`
- [zstack](https://docs.rs/macro.zstack.html)
- A layered `Stack`

## Structs[§](https://docs.rs#structs)

- [Action](https://docs.rs/struct.ActionIcon.html)- Icon
- A compact, square icon button. The Mantine `ActionIcon`.
- [Anchor](https://docs.rs/struct.Anchor.html)
- A text link. The Mantine `Anchor`.
- [Badge](https://docs.rs/struct.Badge.html)
- A compact status pill. The Mantine `Badge`.
- [Blockquote](https://docs.rs/struct.Blockquote.html)
- A quote block. The Mantine `Blockquote`.
- [Button](https://docs.rs/struct.Button.html)
- A clickable button. The Mantine `Button`.
- [Card](https://docs.rs/struct.Card.html)
- A content card. The Mantine `Card`— a`Paper`with sensible defaults.
- [Chip](https://docs.rs/struct.Chip.html)
- A selectable chip. The Mantine `Chip`. Controlled: pass`checked`and a change handler via`cx.listener`, or two-way bind with`Chip::bind`
- [Close](https://docs.rs/struct.CloseButton.html)- Button
- A dismiss button. The Mantine `CloseButton`.
- [Code](https://docs.rs/struct.Code.html)
- Inline code. The Mantine `Code`. (Uses the window font; gpui has no generic monospace fallback, so style a real mono family at the app level if needed.)
- [Collapse](https://docs.rs/struct.Collapse.html)
- Reveals its child with a fade when `open`, renders nothing when closed.
- [Copy](https://docs.rs/struct.CopyButton.html)- Button
- A small button that writes `text`to the system clipboard when clicked, then shows a “Copied” state for a moment. A gpui entity — create with`cx.new(|_| CopyButton::new("…"))`.
- [Divider](https://docs.rs/struct.Divider.html)
- A separator line. The Mantine `Divider`.
- [Icon](https://docs.rs/struct.Icon.html)
- A themed icon glyph. Inherits the parent’s text color unless `color`
- [Image](https://docs.rs/struct.Image.html)
- An image element. The Mantine `Image`.
- [Indicator](https://docs.rs/struct.Indicator.html)
- A corner indicator over any child. The Mantine `Indicator`.
- [Kbd](https://docs.rs/struct.Kbd.html)
- A keyboard key. The Mantine `Kbd`.
- [Mark](https://docs.rs/struct.Mark.html)
- A highlighter-pen span. The Mantine `Mark`.
- [Panel](https://docs.rs/struct.Panel.html)
- A titled surface with header/footer chrome. Reads like `Card`
- [Paper](https://docs.rs/struct.Paper.html)
- A surface container. The Mantine `Paper`.
- [Scroll](https://docs.rs/struct.ScrollArea.html)- Area
- A scrollable region. `ScrollArea::new("id").max_height(240.0)`.
- [Skeleton](https://docs.rs/struct.Skeleton.html)
- A pulsing placeholder block. The Mantine `Skeleton`.
- [Split](https://docs.rs/struct.SplitPanel.html)- Panel
- A resizable two-pane layout. Create with
`cx.new(|cx| SplitPanel::new(cx).first(..).second(..))`and give the element a sized parent — the panel fills it.
- [Spoiler](https://docs.rs/struct.Spoiler.html)
- A collapsible content clip. The Mantine `Spoiler`.
- [Text](https://docs.rs/struct.Text.html)
- Themed body text. The Mantine `Text`.
- [Theme](https://docs.rs/struct.ThemeIcon.html)- Icon
- A decorative colored icon chip. The Mantine `ThemeIcon`.
- [Title](https://docs.rs/struct.Title.html)
- A heading. The Mantine `Title`;`order`1..=6 selects the heading level.
- [Transition](https://docs.rs/struct.Transition.html)
- Plays a one-shot entrance animation around its child.
- [WebView](https://docs.rs/struct.WebView.html)
- A native web view. Create with `cx.new(|cx| WebView::new(cx))`.

## Enums[§](https://docs.rs#enums)

- [Icon](https://docs.rs/enum.IconName.html)- Name
- A named icon. The glyph is resolved by `IconName::glyph`
- [Object](https://docs.rs/enum.ObjectFit.html)- Fit
- How to fit the image into the bounds of the element.
- [Orientation](https://docs.rs/enum.Orientation.html)
- [Split](https://docs.rs/enum.SplitDirection.html)- Direction
- Which way the panes are laid out. `Horizontal`places them side by side (a vertical divider, column-resize cursor);`Vertical`stacks them.
- [Split](https://docs.rs/enum.SplitPanelEvent.html)- Panel - Event
- Emitted while the divider is dragged. Carries the new first-pane ratio
in `0.0..=1.0`.
- [Transition](https://docs.rs/enum.TransitionKind.html)- Kind
- The kind of entrance motion `Transition`
- [WebView](https://docs.rs/enum.WebViewEvent.html)- Event
- Emitted as the embedded page loads and changes.

### impl<ST, DT> [CastableFrom](https://docs.rs/zerocopy/0.8.52/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/zerocopy/pointer/invariant/trait.CastableFrom.html)<ST, [Uninit](https://docs.rs/zerocopy/0.8.52/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/zerocopy/pointer/invariant/enum.Uninit.html), [Uninit](https://docs.rs/zerocopy/0.8.52/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/zerocopy/pointer/invariant/enum.Uninit.html)> for DT

# BarChart in guise::chart - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/guise-ui/0.4.0/guise/chart/struct.BarChart.html

`pub struct BarChart { /* private fields */ }`## Expand description

A vertical bar chart. Bars scale against the largest value with the baseline at zero; negative values clamp to zero (no downward bars in v1). Bar colors rotate through the theme palette by default.

# PieChart in guise::chart - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/guise-ui/0.4.0/guise/chart/struct.PieChart.html

`pub struct PieChart { /* private fields */ }`## Expand description

A pie (or donut) chart. Slices are proportional to each value’s share of the total, starting at 12 o’clock and sweeping clockwise. Non-positive values contribute nothing. Slice colors rotate through the theme palette by default.

Lower width bound, honored by both flex sizing and drag-resizing
(default `60.0`).

Horizontal alignment of the header and cells (default `Align::Start`).

Make the column sortable. A header click cycles ascending → descending → unsorted; the sort is a stable reorder of display indices and never mutates the rows.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.Select)

### Select([usize](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.usize.html))

A tab was clicked; carries its index. The bar has already switched to it.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.Close)

### Close([usize](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.usize.html))

A tab’s close button was clicked; carries its index. The tab is *not*
removed automatically — call [ TabBar::remove_tab](https://docs.rs/struct.TabBar.html#method.remove_tab) to drop it.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.Add)

### Add

The trailing `+` button was clicked.

# TableView in guise::data - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/guise-ui/0.4.0/guise/data/struct.TableView.html

`pub struct TableView<T: 'static> { /* private fields */ }`## Expand description

A rich data table. Create with
`cx.new(|cx| TableView::new(cx).columns(...).rows(...))`.

## Implementations[§](https://docs.rs#implementations)

[Source](https://docs.rs/src/guise/data/tableview/mod.rs.html#216-235)

[Source](https://docs.rs/src/guise/data/tableview/mod.rs.html#237-240)

Bind the rows to a `Signal<Vec<T>>`: the table observes the signal
(signal writes repaint it) and reads the rows at render, so it always
shows the live value. Selection is pruned when rows disappear.

[Source](https://docs.rs/src/guise/data/tableview/mod.rs.html#264-267)

#### pub fn [selection_mode](https://docs.rs#method.selection_mode)(self, mode: [SelectionMode](https://docs.rs/enum.SelectionMode.html)) -> Self

[Source](https://docs.rs/src/guise/data/tableview/mod.rs.html#274-277)

#### pub fn [with_border](https://docs.rs#method.with_border)(self, with_border: [bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html)) -> Self

Fix the body height (px). The body becomes a virtualized
`uniform_list` scroll region — rows must share one height — and the
header stays outside it, so it is sticky for free.

Rendered instead of the body when there are no rows.

Replace the rows with a new owned snapshot (drops any signal binding).

[Source](https://docs.rs/src/guise/data/tableview/mod.rs.html#324-326)

# TableViewEvent in guise::data - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/guise-ui/0.4.0/guise/data/enum.TableViewEvent.html

```
pub enum TableViewEvent {
    SelectionChanged(
```
[Vec](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/vec/struct.Vec.html)<[usize](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.usize.html)>),
    Activated([usize](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.usize.html)),
    Sorted([Option](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/option/enum.Option.html)<([usize](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.usize.html), [SortDir](https://docs.rs/enum.SortDir.html))>),
}## Expand description

## Variants[§](https://docs.rs#variants)

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.SelectionChanged)

The set of selected source rows changed (ascending indices).

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.Activated)

### Activated([usize](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.usize.html))

A row was activated by double-click or Enter.

# Editor in guise::editor - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/guise-ui/0.4.0/guise/editor/struct.Editor.html

`pub struct Editor { /* private fields */ }`## Expand description

A multiline code editor. Create with `cx.new(|cx| Editor::new(cx))`.

The text model is the unit-tested [ EditorModel](https://docs.rs/struct.EditorModel.html) (char-index cursor,
anchor selection, coalesced undo). Read-only editors still support
selection and copy — only mutations are blocked.

## Implementations[§](https://docs.rs#implementations)

Window-space origin of the caret’s cell — where a completion popup or search bar anchors. Tracks both scroll axes; meaningless before the first paint (returns the content origin).

Two-way bind this editor’s text to a `Signal<String>`. The signal is
the source of truth: the editor adopts its value now, edits write back
through [ Signal::set_if_changed](https://docs.rs/reactive/struct.Signal.html#method.set_if_changed), and signal writes replace the text.
Equality guards on both directions prevent update loops.

# EditorEvent in guise::editor - Rust

# EditorModel in guise::editor - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/guise-ui/0.4.0/guise/editor/struct.EditorModel.html

`pub struct EditorModel { /* private fields */ }`## Expand description

A multiline editing model with cursor, selection, and undo history.

The document is a `Vec<String>` of lines (no trailing `\n` stored); an
empty document is one empty line. All columns are char indices, so
multibyte text (é, 日本語) edits correctly. Runs of single-char typing
coalesce into one undo step; any other edit or movement breaks the run.

Insert `s` at the cursor, replacing the selection if there is one.
Embedded newlines split lines; CRLF is normalized to `\n`.

Delete the selection, or the char before the cursor (joining lines at a line start). Returns whether anything changed.

Delete the selection, or the char at the cursor (joining lines at a line end). Returns whether anything changed.

Split the line at the cursor, auto-indenting the new line with the current line’s leading whitespace (capped at the cursor column, so splitting inside the indent doesn’t over-indent).

# ToastStack in guise::feedback - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/guise-ui/0.4.0/guise/feedback/struct.ToastStack.html

`pub struct ToastStack { /* private fields */ }`## Expand description

A stack of toasts. Create with `cx.new(|_| ToastStack::new())` and render it
inside a full-size root.

#### pub fn [new](https://docs.rs#method.new)() -> Self

Set the auto-dismiss delay for subsequently pushed toasts. `None`
keeps toasts until closed. Chainable, so it slots into construction:
`cx.new(|_| ToastStack::new().duration(None))`.
